name: How long does a kitchen renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on the scope of work. A cosmetic update involving cabinet refacing, new countertops, and minor fixture swaps typically takes 3 to 5 weeks. A complete gut renovation or layout reconfiguration usually requires 6 to 10 weeks or more once construction begins. Several factors affect timing, including permit approval, structural wall modifications, plumbing relocations, and lead times for custom cabinets or specialized fixtures. Ordering materials early and finalizing floor plans before demolition helps prevent mid-project delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen renovations take between 3 and 10 weeks of active construction, depending on whether the project is a cosmetic refresh or a full structural remodel.
